Perennial allergies: Treats allergy symptoms that persist year-round, caused by allergens such as dust, mold, or pet dander. description: Latanoprost is an ophthalmic solution used to treat certain eye conditions. It works by helping to regulate intraocular pressure. Ocular hypertension: It is prescribed to lower elevated pressure in the eye that has not necessarily caused damage but is a risk factor for developing glaucoma. Mechanism of action Latanoprost is a prostaglandin analogue that works by increasing the drainage of aqueous humor, the natural fluid found in the eye. By improving the outflow of this fluid, it reduces the internal pressure of the eye. For eye use only: Latanoprost is an ophthalmic solution, meaning it is only applied to the eyes. Use with caution if you wear contact lenses: If you wear contact lenses, you must remove them before applying the drops and wait at least 15 minutes before reinserting them.
